import json, sys

import unittest
from tests.test_workflow_commands import WorkflowCommandTests
from delegate_agent.workflows import registry as workflow_registry


class Probe(WorkflowCommandTests):
    def test_probe_frozen_copy_edit_hash(self) -> None:
        script = self.write_workflow('meta = {"name": "probe"}\nreturn "orig"')
        launch = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "run", str(script)])
        self.assertEqual(launch.returncode, 0, launch.stderr)
        lp = json.loads(launch.stdout)
        wf_id = lp["wfId"]
        self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "wait", wf_id, "--timeout", "10"])
        frozen = Path(lp["scriptPath"])
        frozen.write_text('meta = {"name": "probe"}\nreturn "EDITED-FROZEN"\n', encoding="utf-8")
        actual = workflow_registry.script_sha256(frozen.read_bytes())
        resumed = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "run", "--resume", wf_id])
        rp = json.loads(resumed.stdout)
        print("PROBE recorded=", lp["scriptSha256"])
        print("PROBE reported_on_resume=", rp.get("scriptSha256"))
        print("PROBE actual_frozen_hash=", actual)
        print("PROBE warnings=", rp.get("warnings"))
        self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "wait", wf_id, "--timeout", "10"])
        res = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "result", wf_id])
        print("PROBE result=", json.loads(res.stdout)["result"])

    def test_probe_dryrun_text_warnings(self) -> None:
        script = self.write_workflow('import random\nmeta = {"name": "probe2"}\nlog(str(random.random()))\nreturn None')
        text = self.run_delegate(["workflow", "run", str(script), "--dry-run"])
        js = self.run_delegate(["--json", "workflow", "run", str(script), "--dry-run"])
        print("PROBE json_warnings=", json.loads(js.stdout).get("warnings"))
        print("PROBE text_stdout_head=", repr(text.stdout[:400]))
        print("PROBE text_stderr=", repr(text.stderr[:400]))
        try:
            json.loads(text.stdout)
            print("PROBE text_stdout_is_json= True")
        except Exception as exc:
            print("PROBE text_stdout_is_json= False", exc)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    loader = unittest.TestLoader()
    suite = unittest.TestSuite([Probe("test_probe_frozen_copy_edit_hash"), Probe("test_probe_dryrun_text_warnings")])

EOF
